sources.title: TheBloke/Llama-2-7B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Description This repo contains GGUF format model files for Meta's Llama 2 7B. About GGUF GGUF is a new format introduced by the llama.cpp team on August 21st 2023. It is a replacement for GGML, which is no longer supported by llama.cpp. GGUF offers numerous advantages over GGML, such as better tokenisation, and support for special tokens.

sources.title: Llama-2-7B-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Q: How does this compare to the Chat variant? A: This base model generates raw text continuation and requires manual prompt engineering. The Llama-2-7B-Chat-GGUF is instruction-tuned for conversational interaction, producing more natural responses to user queries without special prompt formatting.
